npcx: adc: only enable ADC during conversion for power consumption. For better power consumption in npcx series ec, this CL only turns on ADC module before starting conversion and turns it off after the conversion is done. If ec enters deep sleep when ADC conversion is ongoing, the conveting process is suspended until next time ec wakes up from the deep sleep. Considering the frequency of ADC's source clock is up to 15MHz, it's more efficient to forbid ec enter deep sleep when the conversion is proceeding. (Each conversion time of ADC channel is ~200us based on this condition.) Forbidding ec enter deep sleep has no harm for VCC power consumption. BRANCH=none BUG=none TEST=No build errors for npcx7 series. The current of AVCC is reduced from 0.4mA to ~0.001mA on yorp if this patch is applied.
